title: Triage rotation handshake and secrets roadmap (April 20 2026)
content:
Purpose: quick sync notes from the 2026-04-20 security-engineering triage handoff. This is focused on rotation of the triage pager, immediate vuln dispositions, the secrets rotation pilot, and a short threat-modeling follow-up.

Attendees: Rohan Patel (owner), Maya Thompson, Elena Garcia, Samir Joshi, Liam O'Connor, guest: Priya Rao (SRE).

Context and tone: informal working notes intended to capture decisions, open questions, and owner commitments. Not a finalized runbook — follow-ups below.

1) Triage rotation handoff notes
- Rotation summary: Samir's two-week rotation ends 2026-04-22 at 0900 PDT. Handoff checklist completed except for two backlog items (see below).
- Backlog items for incoming oncall (Maya, starting 2026-04-22):
  - Finish triage write-up for low-risk findings from scan run 2026-04-18 (asset tags: infra/cfn, infra/k8s). Partial draft at CONFLUENCE-SEC; ETA 2026-04-23.
  - Confirm remediation window with Infra for AzBatch worker nodes (JIRA-SEC-1987) — vulnerability flagged as CVSS 6.1, exploit complexity low but requires rolling restart.
- Escalation path reminder: for high/critical findings (CVSS >=7.5 or active exploit evidence), page sec-eng-oncall -> follow escalation steps in oncall runbook link.
- Decision: we will start tagging triage tickets with a "rotation-owner" field so historical ownership is clearer. Action: Rohan to open infra PR to add the field to the triage board (github issue created, PR#842 referenced). ETA 2026-04-24.

2) Vulnerability dispositions (summary of live items)
- JIRA-SEC-1972: Outdated bcrypt library in internal auth-service. Severity: medium. Workaround: temporary WAF rule to throttle auth attempts. Fix plan: upgrade dependency and run canary in staging. Owners: Elena + dev-auth. ETA: 2026-05-05.
- JIRA-SEC-1987: AzBatch worker kernel CVE (mentioned above). Severity: high. Decision: schedule maintenance window with Infra for 2026-04-29 to apply kernel patch and validate job rescheduling. Owner: Priya (SRE) + Samir.
- JIRA-SEC-1999: S3 bucket ACL misconfiguration found by external scan; low severity, no public access. Owner: Maya. Remediation: tighten bucket policy and add automated guardrail; ETA 2026-04-27.

3) Secrets rotation pilot (compact plan and risks)
- Goal: reduce blast radius from long-lived service credentials and ensure automated rotation for high-privilege keys by Q3 2026. Pilot scope: 3 services (auth-service, model-store-sync, billing-reporter).
- Proposed approach: use KMS-backed short-lived credentials + sidecar token fetcher for pods; integrate with existing KMS (cloud-KMS) and HSM for enterprise customers.
- Pilot milestones:
  - Week 0 (now -> 2026-05-07): finalize token-exchange RFC and change proposal. Owner: Elena.
  - Week 2 (2026-05-08 -> 2026-05-21): deploy sidecar pattern in staging for auth-service. Owner: Samir.
  - Week 4 (2026-05-22 -> 2026-06-04): run fault-injection (token expiry/latency) tests, measure failure modes. Owner: Maya + SRE.
- Short-term mitigations: rotate high-risk keys immediately where rotation is manual (billing-reporter). Action: Rohan to coordinate with infra on key rotation windows; done: rotation scheduled 2026-04-28 02:00 UTC.
- Risks and open questions:
  - Secret-scanning false positives causing churn in triage. Proposal: tune scanner to ignore narrow false-positive rules and surface confidence levels. Owner: Elena.
  - Sidecar token fetcher latency under cold-starts — need performance budget. Owner: Samir to add a small benchmark suite by 2026-05-10.

4) Threat modeling follow-up items (short notes)
- Focus area: model-serving surface (inference endpoints) — threat hypotheses: data exfiltration via prompt injection, model poisoning via training artifact ingestion, and supply-chain risk for quantized model artifacts.
- Outcome from workshop: prioritize defenses in this order: input/output sanitization, artifact signing verification, registry attestation.
- Action: create a lightweight checklist for engineering teams that are onboarding models into hosted/dedicated/private deployments. Owner: Rohan, draft due 2026-05-03.
- Note: product teams requested a non-blocking evaluation flag to run models in "observability mode" before full rollout. Consider adding this as a rollout policy in Console. Owner: Product (Emily K.) — Rohan to sync.

5) Playbook and tooling updates (quick wins)
- Add a triage ticket template field for "service-impact estimate" to speed prioritization decisions. Owner: Rohan.
- Add an automated check that flags long-lived personal keys in vaults older than 90 days. Owner: Elena + infra security. ETA: 2026-05-14.
- Integrate secret-scan suppression comments with triage tickets so that developer context is preserved (avoid re-triage churn). Owner: Samir.

6) Action items recap (owner -> task -> ETA)
- Rohan: add rotation-owner field to triage board (PR#842) -> 2026-04-24.
- Elena: finalize token-exchange RFC -> 2026-05-07.
- Samir: deploy sidecar in staging & add benchmark suite -> 2026-05-10 for benchmark, staging deploy by 2026-05-21.
- Maya: remediate S3 bucket ACL and complete scan write-up -> 2026-04-27 and 2026-04-23 respectively.
- Priya (SRE): schedule AzBatch kernel maintenance and confirm rollback plan -> 2026-04-29.

7) Notes to self / loose threads
- Collect historical oncall ownership stats to see if rotation length should be adjusted (2 weeks -> maybe 1 week) — Rohan will pull data next week.
- Consider a "mini-blitz" to close low-effort low-risk tickets from the backlog during the next rotation window.
- Check if external scanner vendor has an update to reduce false-positive rate for our infra templates (open ticket with vendor).

8) Next sync and what to bring
- Next triage handoff quick sync: 2026-04-27 08:30 PDT. Bring: status of kernel maintenance, secrets rotation RFC draft, and any regression evidence from sidecar tests.

If anything above is unclear, ping me (Rohan) in #sec-eng with subject line: "triage-handshake APR20".

-- end of notes --
